title: Multiple modular L-functions and modular iterated integrals
summary: The connection between multiple modular L-functions, as defined by Manin in [5], and modular iterated integrals was made explicit by Choie and Ihara [3] under the restrictive assumption that all modular forms involved have vanishing constant terms in their q-expansions. In this paper, we remove the assumption and establish the relationship between modular iterated integrals and multiple modular L-functions for general modular forms, including those with nonzero constant terms.
